text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Photoreal cinematic blue-hour elevated tram platform in a near-future city, rain-slick ceramic tiles, translucent canopy, empty amber-lit tram at left, distant quiet towers. Elegant indigo and electric cyan with restrained amber light, soft luminous rain haze, readable shadow detail, 50mm cinematic perspective.
